trial_court: Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Koteranka, Rajouri (CRM(M) No. 321/2023)
case_name: Kashmir Singh vs Ut Of Jammu And Kashmir And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: Ut of Jammu and Kashmir and another — wife

facts_of_case: Kashmir Singh's marriage with respondent No.2 was solemnized on 19.04.2019. Due to personal differences and dispute, respondent No.2 came out of the matrimonial society and started living separately. She lodged FIR against Kashmir Singh, which resulted in a challan before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Koteranka. The parties settled their disputes and filed a petition for grant of divorce by mutual consent before the Family Court, Jammu.

outcome.final_order: The petitioner's petition seeking quashment of challan/charge-sheet is allowed. The parties have amicably settled their matrimonial dispute and a decree of divorce by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act has been granted.
